payload.title: Wait for terminal optimizer evidence before review
payload.description:
As an account operator, I want the portfolio run to wait durably for child optimizers and evaluations, so that running work is never reported as a completed improvement.

Feature: Durable optimizer outcome waiting

Scenario: Healthy child work remains active
  Given an approved optimizer child is queued or running
  When the portfolio procedure reaches the outcome phase
  Then the parent checkpoints without holding compute
  And the living Report shows the child as running
  And no terminal review or promotion request is produced

Scenario: Child work reaches terminal evidence
  Given a persisted optimizer child handle
  When its procedure and required evaluations become terminal
  Then the portfolio procedure resumes
  And reviews the exact terminal evidence once

Scenario: Sibling outcomes are isolated
  Given several approved optimizer children
  When some complete and another fails or remains active
  Then completed evidence remains visible
  And each child receives its own disposition
  And no healthy evaluation is cancelled or failed by a fixed timeout
